syllabus.title: Practice Test 01 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Basic Maths and Calculus (Complete chapter)
• Vectors (Till Vector addition only)

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Classification of matter, Temperature scales, Scientific Notation, Significant figure
• Structure of Atom: Introduction, Atomic Models, Some Important Atomic Terms,
• Nature of Light and Electromagnetic Spectrum, Planck’s Quantum Theory,
• Bohr's Model for Hydrogen Atom.

📌 BOTANY
• Cell - The Unit of Life : What is a Cell ?, Discovery of the Cell Microscopy, Cell Theory, Overview of Cell, Types of cell, Structure of Prokaryotic cell, Prokaryotic cells, Eukaryotic cells, Endomembrane system.

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Structural Organization in Animals: Tissues, Animal Tissues, Epithelium Tissue.
